mission.title: Opening Boxes
mission.description: Pick up a recording intercepted by Anome's device, then answer an emergency meeting's call.

npc.say: Don't tell a soul, got it? If any higher ups in Zion find out about this...
We've all got to work together to stop her!
Stay focused, {player}. We all need to focus on the task, not let anger cloud our judgment.
Veil better pray I don't find her first...
You sure of all the people on your hovercraft? Boy, this really has me freaked, remembering what happened...

Talk to your operator, and with Tyndall, {player}. They'll keep you up to date.
Don't worry, we'll pull together and take care of this situation.

phase.briefing:
Hey, {player}. Looks like we're turning up some info on this Cryptos guy already. We're pickin' up so much info from that device you planted... this is great!
Head to this location. I need you to take a look at something we picked up. It's some sort of recording.

enter.say: Eos is in here with that recording.

done.say: Hmm... I think you'd better upload that to me and I'll have a look at it.

objective.text: Upload the recording at a hardline

phase.briefing:
All right, all we need to do now is listen to that and--
Hold up. Looks like an emergency meeting's been called. You need to get over there now, {player}!

enter.say: An emergency meeting! I wonder what's going on... I guess we're going to find out.

talk.say:
{player}! Get in here... you have to hear this.
Veil is out.
That's right, Veil. Remember her? We used to all call her Toorima. She was on board the Novalis II, until...
We've all got to work together to stop her!
Stay focused, {player}. We all need to focus on the task, not let anger cloud our judgment.

Hey, cool it, Cebriones; {player} needs to hear this.
Veil turned out to be pretty high up in the masked men's organization. Sadly for all of us, we didn't find out until after she sabotaged Vashuo's cranial jack. Imagine having a traitor in your crew, and you didn't have a clue until someone's jackout procedure didn't work... and there they are, dead...
Veil better pray I don't find her first...

All right, so we're all up to speed. Now the question is this: What do we do?
Number one: All masked men are kill on sight, unless you hear otherwise. We've never been friendly with them, but they have now become our prime target.
Number two: Find Veil. I don't think she just up and left, never to be seen again... she'll be around the Matrix. No matter what it takes, we'll track her down and retake her... or kill her in the process.
Everybody understand?

Veil's out! This is unbelievable! This is... A lot of people were involved in her capture.
I've downloaded that recording to your inventory. Hopefully it will shed some sort of light on this...

mission.finish:
Veil, that underhanded, conniving... She'll get hers. Don't worry about that, {player}. I'll see to it personally.
Keep in touch.
